# Pitex 1.1.0

This release updates the Pi assistant to 1.5.2 and changes which providers
you can pick.

## Changes

- Installing the Pi assistant on macOS, Ubuntu and Windows now installs
  Pi 1.5.2.
- Claude Code is available as a direct provider.
- Apple Foundation Models is available as a direct on-device provider on
  supported Macs with Apple Intelligence. Reads and writes stay inside the
  project. Pitex asks for approval before writing a file. A long prompt is
  trimmed to fit the model context.
- Codex and Grok now run through Pi. Settings hides their direct rows.
- Switching provider in the middle of a turn no longer leaves Stop showing.
  The composer shows Send again.

## Install

Pitex 1.0.0 through 1.0.7 update to 1.1.0 from Settings or, with automatic
installation enabled, at launch. For Homebrew installations, run
`brew update` and `brew upgrade --cask pitex`.

Builds from the earlier 2.x line do not update automatically; install 1.1.0
from the downloads below. Pitex Nightly continues to use its separate
update channel.

## Downloads

Downloads include the macOS ARM64 DMG, Ubuntu 22.04 and 24.04 AMD64 DEBs,
Windows AMD64 installer and portable ZIP, the Ubuntu installer, and
SHA256SUMS.
Windows remains beta.
